# ELK layout engine

`elk.bundled.js` is the unmodified browser bundle from `elkjs` **0.12.0**.
It computes the directed, compound graph layout. Corylus renders its own SVG
cards, epic boundaries and ticket table; no CDN or npm runtime is required.

- Upstream: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/elkjs/-/elkjs-0.12.0.tgz
- Package SHA-512 (base64):
  `YZcKynxVxYoKIOEpywEPwCFdg+BTbxQRNf3pbwdDCvc8O3kQD8bmIwSxKU1eOTVc4Xo+VG9Te+575mlfvOrhEQ==`
- Bundle SHA-256:
  `1222e44f953ce7746af23801e723708f8e6f436b8b377a6a5fc7552f34a307b3`
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0, included in `ELK-LICENSE.md`.

To update, select a release, verify the downloaded npm tarball against its
registry integrity, copy only the bundle and license, update these hashes, and
run the model and browser checks. Preserve the source package's license.
